claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.171 Python browser evidence where the prior export-warning blocker cleared, but the package still blocked at 98/A because enriched slide decks averaged only 4.2 content-bearing slides.
Sparse kernel/depth-marked decks now have a fifth deterministic content-floor teaching slide available, so the repair can reach the grader's five-content-slide floor from zero credited base content.
Decks with only zero, one, or two credited teaching-body slides are treated as genuinely sparse and receive five deterministic top-up slides instead of stopping after a few weak base slides count.
Deterministic content-floor slides still preserve authored bullets and notes through the existing enriched-slide passthrough path.
The release explicitly does not claim a fresh clean ZIP score; deployed v0.15.172 still needs a GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit.
